Name: Esau
Role: Son of Isaac; Father of Edom
Summary: Esau was Isaac's firstborn twin, a skillful hunter who traded his birthright for a bowl of stew. He became the father of the nation of Edom.
KeyStory: Hungry after hunting, Esau sold his birthright to Jacob for bread and lentil stew, despising what was most valuable.
LifeLesson: Esau traded the lasting for the immediate — a warning we all need. Do not let a moment of appetite cost you what God meant for your future.
